title: Spring 2027: CMF Industrial Design Co-op (January through June)
note: Color, materials and finish for home appliances.

facts.summary: Six-month CMF co-op on the Shark and Ninja design teams.
facts.duties: Tracks color specs, builds color-palette proposals and a materials library, writes trend reports, and does some icon, UI and label work.
facts.requirements: Adobe Suite, KeyShot rendering, and familiarity with Pantone, NCS, SPI and Mold-Tech standards.
facts.apply: Apply on Greenhouse and include work samples, either linked in the resume or added as a cover letter.
